listNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation and matched by PSNProfiles and Exophase. Guides are written for this entry in the author's own words and cite their sources beside each trophy. Anything the sources had not confirmed by 19 Nov 2026 is labelled UNCONFIRMED in its guide.

trophies.guide: There is nothing extra to do for the platinum: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. In practice A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, is the longest grind, so it is almost always the last trophy before this one. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is an unmissable story trophy: play the first mission and it pops on completion. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it unlocks once the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, is done, and Output Lag warns chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene — either way, just keep playing the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it unlocks once the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, is done. It cannot be missed: there is no way to finish the story without it. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so do not worry if it does not pop the instant the Chapter 3 finale ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 4. PowerPyx lists the Chapter 4 finale, Starting From Zero, as the trigger. Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter anyway: there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back if you want to redo anything. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. PowerPyx lists the Chapter 4 finale, Starting From Zero, as the mission that closes the story. Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is the only way to replay the ending. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It is an unmissable story trophy that pops when the mission ends. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Open the 100% checklist after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing on the list is missable. The targets are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion, for example any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 large bank jobs and all 39 gang operations. Do optional missions as they appear — any 100 count — and most of the list fills itself while you chase the other trophies. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix them and pick the easiest. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250. Track progress under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you play the story and chase other trophies, so this usually pops without a dedicated grind. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations (PowerPyx's range guide covers all 42). Gold medals here are not too difficult, and range time also levels up your Focus, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total. You only need one win per location, not every race. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can skip the ones you find hardest and still have twice as many to choose from. Race wins also count toward the activity types for Master of None. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui. Some time after that, Cal sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline and beat him in his challenge. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Complete all five of her quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, and his green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map; dive for the treasures, using the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring them back. There are 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3 — as Jason, calling Brian speeds up his return text. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's optional questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete all five of his quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the last one. The quests stay available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Only some questlines count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, because they have their own trophies or are not counted as strangers. Watch the trophy's own progress counter after each strand. Warning: Yago's Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon), so save first and race the moment it appears. Strangers stay available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on his list, then drive it back — a car in good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's optional questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy enough labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and Tyrone then gives you Spin On This, which closes the questline and pops the trophy. It stays available after the story. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, tracking them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Meditate at a spot with both Jason and Lucia and it counts twice, so always bring your partner. MISSABLE — READ THIS FIRST: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow and choose Accept. That balcony meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends. PowerPyx notes it is still unclear whether it is strictly required for the trophy, so do it anyway and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Finish Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. PARTLY UNCONFIRMED: PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy, and that all 15 Target Decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx's collectible guide lists 18 card set locations, so pick the three sets whose cards you find first and finish those. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations by holding Up and then R1 to scan objects in the world. Any 100 count, and there are more than 100: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan everything you pass while playing and this fills up on its own. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. You need 70 of 80 for the 100% checklist, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. Most challenges complete naturally while you chase other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest ones you have left. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can play Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (not just the flashing blue-red search area) for the trophy to pop. A fast sports motorcycle works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because the helicopter cannot see you there. It also pops on its own while robbing bank vaults, which always give 4 stars. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you (call them by holding Right and pressing Triangle), rob three shops in a row while the police keep chasing you — if the wanted stars fade completely, the chain breaks. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well, once they are open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan. Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic passing by. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models, so this pops automatically on the way there. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is slow-motion aiming: press L3 and R3 together while aiming a firearm. It drains the purple focus bar and only lasts a few seconds, so line up five enemies first, then trigger it and drop them all without missing. Eat, drink or use Adrenaline to extend focus, wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto weapon such as the Duke 556 assault rifle. Gang-operation guards are good targets. PowerPyx reports the trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, and that Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by late game you will likely be at Focus level 4 and this gets much easier. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — planes parked on the open airfield do not count. The easiest are the ones at gates E3 and E4: go through a fence around the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive it backwards to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — it is delayed, so keep flying. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the far south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without anyone spotting you. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which is marked automatically from story progress: tail a security van to a large bank, slip into the vault while the guard has it open, and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone. After that, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000, after his earlier quests) to find more vaults. Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank jobs; the 100% checklist needs all 8. Each vault gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to shake the heat. A single vault can pay up to $205,000. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easiest way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, the same mission that opens bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier, you can also stop an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops once you escape the red heat radius, so get clear or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy pops automatically on the way there. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026). The description points to having a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach, but no source has confirmed which venue or action triggers it. Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one; check back after more players finish the game. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy's unlock as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026). The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's front, but no source has confirmed which showroom or exactly what counts. Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn — an illegal gang operation you first visit in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation. Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the north-east table, and blow open the office safe with a sticky bomb. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. If you miss one, the operation's robbery icon respawns later, so you can return for the rest — it is not missable. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check each character's Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the heart icon. Only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership and work out with your partner alongside you — call them with Right + Triangle — because while one character trains, the other trains too, doubling your progress. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the PSN trophy tracker shows your count out of 500. Turn on profile notifications first under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies, fights and escapes all feed it, and the profile grades your style from Professional through Hardened and Violent to Psycho — an Irredeemable profile is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight, so avoid piling on excessive violence. It fills passively while you chase everything else; if it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but expect the police to get much more aggressive. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is only a guess — no source has confirmed the trigger. Do not chase a specific action until a guide confirms one. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline. The description fits a strange encounter, but no source has confirmed where it happens or what triggers it. Do not chase a specific spot until a guide confirms one. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified method exists yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description points to a melee attack from a moving bike, but no source has confirmed the exact move or target. Do not chase a specific method until a guide confirms one. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew — that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist, and a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types — the total is cumulative, not one purchase. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money, since they are the most expensive. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend in. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which together cost $160,000. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver: you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy through that app. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3 and 4. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses. It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you anywhere. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each vehicle needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes), and register cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the cost down. Sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
trophies.name: On the Spot
